checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume

The base shaded on the chart is visibly wide and choppy across roughly 39 sessions with overlapping bars and no clear tightening, confirming the C FAIL. The burst bar itself closes near its high but the range expansion is absent and volume is soft, making the signal structurally weak.
claude.key_risk: A 39-session base with 58% giveback and sub-average volume on the signal day means there is no compression behind the move and no institutional conviction visible.
